description: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 flagship video generation model released June 23, 2026 at the Volcano Engine FORCE Conference. Delivers up to 30 seconds of native 4K 10-bit video in a single forward pass with unified joint audio-video generation architecture. Supports up to 50 multimodal reference inputs (images, videos, audio) for character and brand identity consistency, native local scene editing without re-generation, and 3D white-box previs for cinematic previsualization. Skipped versions 2.1-2.4 to signal a generational architectural leap over Seedance 2.0.
